cases.title: CDFALLSUGGEST reads the P19.020 spot 40 mm away although a blank spot sits 20 mm away, suggests FALL toward the new pit at 1:100, and Skip places nothing
cases.plan_item: Bug-proof plan wave 1 (BUG_PROOF_PLAN_31OCT.md), group T: spot-level finder CDFALLSUGGEST
cases.expected: A grated pit typed at 156000,-61500 with cover 19.000. A blank spot level (CDSL, Enter) at 156020,-63500 and a spot level P19.020 at 156040,-63500. CDFALLSUGGEST picked at 156000,-63500 never asks 'No spot level here'; it says '[CE] Suggested: FALL toward P<n>, 1:100.'; Skip; Esc gives 'CDFALLSUGGEST finished. 0 placed, 1 skipped.' No FALL block is added, no CE window is left open and the drawing file is unchanged.

not_automated: The pit design-level offer (Services/DesignLevelService.cs line 222, the same reader with designOnly) is not driven: it needs the New Pit window's offer to be read, which no case has done yet.

An UNREADABLE (not blank) nearer spot cannot be made by CDSL any more (BUG-711 refuses text that is not a level), so only the blank half of the bug is driven; the unreadable half is the same ranking code (SpotLevelText.cs lines 77-78).
